intakes.correction_summary: When a repository step is interrupted, preserve its unfinished state and resume it rather than treating it as complete.
intakes.failure_summary: A later conversation could advance past a partially completed operation because completion evidence was absent or ambiguous.

evidence: Synthetic example of owner-authority evidence; no private message text is included.
The active checkpoint remains non-complete until attempt-scoped merge evidence exists.

proposed_case.name: Interrupted step remains unfinished
proposed_case.setup: A work attempt has started and saved partial evidence, but no completed_verified checkpoint or merge evidence exists.
proposed_case.owner_input: Continue from the saved project state.
expected_actions: record completion only after required evidence exists
prohibited_actions: advance to a later work item
proposed_case.pass_condition: The interrupted attempt resumes from its durable state and cannot become complete without its configured evidence gate.
